rows.notes: Read lines 114-138: query branches pick one of search?q= / news/source/{s} / news/latest (3 paths); source branch first GETs /sources directory (121-125) and only raises/continues from its result - second request is gated by first, no row merge, join_needed=true per cboe preflight convention. Rows come out of the body as a flat top-level JSON array, one item per row, no paging. Client-side filtering check: transform_data (148-157) drops NO rows after the source returns its list - term/source filtering is server-side via URL; what happens client-side is column drop (id/uid/body_preview/site/domain, 149-153), __alias_dict__ rename published->date/body->text/img->images (34-38), scalar img wrapped to list (154-156), and date re-format to America/New_York via pandas to_datetime/tz_convert/strftime (48-59). response_callback (93-102) turns a dict-with-message body into UnauthorizedError/OpenBBError.
